From: "Karoo Mutual Bank" <alerts@karoomutual-online.example>
To: "Accounts" <accounts@baydental.example>
Subject: Urgent: Confirm your sign-in details to restore access
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:03:15 +0000
Message-ID: <judge-walkthrough-001@karoomutual-online.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
X-IsItLegit-Synthetic: true
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Dear client,

We noticed unusual activity on your Karoo Mutual Bank business profile. For your safety we have placed a temporary hold on online access.

Confirm your sign-in details now to restore full access and avoid interruption to payments:

https://karoomutual.demo.isitlegit.co.za/login?ref=judge001

You will be asked for your username, password and contact number. This takes less than five minutes.

Karoo Mutual Bank
